claims.body: The Lightning are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Wild are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Lightning.

claims.head: The Wild don’t own Vasilevskiy
claims.body: Vasilevskiy has been shaky against the Wild since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.

claims.gist: Don’t read much into Vasilevskiy’s record against the Wild.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 2 of their last 3 games, including the last one. Nikita Kucherov takes shifts on two lines, L1 and L3. Victor Hedman is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Černák and Crozier.
John Carlson is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, down from 47% with his old team last season.

stakes: The Wild go in third in the Central with 5 points, the Lightning tied for second in the Atlantic with 4 points.

TBL.head: Advantage, the Lightning
TBL.body: Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Wild can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

MIN.head: The Wild face a real test
MIN.body: Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Wild can pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: Best vs. best
paras: The Lightning have won two in a row. The Wild are 2-0-1. Two of the league’s best teams meet.

It’s strength against strength: the Lightning are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Wild are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. Don’t read much into Vasilevskiy’s record against the Wild.

items.text: The Wild have been without Brock Faber all season.

Nikita Kucherov has a point in six straight games against Minnesota.
Ilya Mikheyev is one goal from 100.
